create_augmenter: create an Augmenter instance with named augmentations, parameters, and mask settings for watermark robustness testing
run_augmenter_forward: run the Augmenter forward pass on watermarked images to apply random augmentations and return augmented outputs with mask targets
test_get_dummy_augmenter: test the get_dummy_augmenter function that returns an identity-only Augmenter for baseline comparisons
review_parse_augmentations: review the parse_augmentations method that builds a list of augmentation objects with normalized selection probabilities
summarize_augment: summarize the augment method that selects one augmentation by probability and applies it to an image and mask pair
